scoring_justification: Barriers and overall energy are compared to paper-reported values with tolerances; trend check on energy ordering. Raw DFT total energies are not available for a full recompute, so reference match is the appropriate tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for activation barriers and overall reaction energy
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Fig. 1: activation barriers (19.6, 9.1, 9.0 kcal/mol) and overall ΔE = -79.3 kcal/mol.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the actual reported values

schema.description: Each value is a relative energy in kcal/mol. reactants must be 0.0.

outputs.description: The agent's computed relative energies. The checker will derive activation barriers and overall reaction energy, compare against hidden gold values with tolerances, and verify the monotonic energy ordering (Int1 < reactants, Int2 < Int1, product < Int2).

output_contract.notes: The DFT procedure uses gas-phase B3LYP/6-31G. Any open-source DFT code is acceptable. The checker tests both the numerical values and the required downward trend.

steps.description: Energy ordering: Int1 < 0, Int2 < Int1, product < Int2
